Edital.title: Edital
Edital.description: Represents a syllabus/edital imported into the application.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this edital.

areas.description: Areas array. Given its size, this will be stored as an array to minimize reads, or as JSON. Storing the whole edital as a JSON tree is acceptable since it's generally < 1MB and requested wholesale.

isPublic.description: Optional flag to indicate if this edital is publicly viewable/shareable.

/editais/{editalId}.description: Stores edital documents containing the structured view.
